verdict: No production correctness blocker found in the frozen component; ready for the unified gate. Conditional on the explicit no-external-ZIL-exports executable contract, not a source-private inference.

production_closure.finding: Default-off option rejects early-closed combination, non-O2, non-API, non-Linux and absent entry. Original partition and O2 input construction are unchanged.

The nonforeign/environment-free generated-name inventory only identifies definitions covered by the explicit closed contract. All actual CGU modules are scanned, including available_externally bodies. Every cross-unit function reference and every pre-O2 symbol operand except an exact direct-call callee is excluded; global initializers are included. Duplicate canonical owners disable admission.

Op::values is exhaustive over current instructions; Val::symbols recursively visits arrays and GEP pointer/indices. Direct-callee exemption uses pointer identity, so the same function passed as a call argument is still excluded.
Plan owns the exact module triple/items and canonical sorted candidate names. API validates this complete input binding before compiling. Diagnostic fingerprint is not authority.
Original full pipeline completes, replay failure handling and original verify run, then a separate DCE phase starts. No early internalization or altered inline decisions.

Current post-O2 module rejects rooted metadata, module assembly, aliases and ifuncs. Current structured model cannot construct inline assembly/DbgRecords; no blanket permission for future new model forms is inferred.

All candidate checks precede mutation: present definition, External linkage, use_empty, no comdat, default visibility/storage, no prefix/prologue/personality/GC. This retains llvm.used/compiler.used, ctor/dtor, constant and remaining-call users. Only selected functions change to Internal, followed by one globaldce and verification. Full actual before/after definition sets determine the removal report.

phase(3) clears borrowed analysis memo identities before the second LLVMRunPasses invocation. Function-stage replay requires phase==1. No stale FAM identity or original FPM replay is used for the DCE invocation.
Replay-failure fresh-context fallback retains the same late policy and regenerates the final report; no fallback silently drops DCE policy.

cache_and_provenance.finding: Policy changes the cache namespace before directory selection. Existing compiler/library/config identity remains. Late policy disables the old object-patch path.
Unit action key binds full module plus exact candidate names. A different whole-project closure changing candidate names changes the unit key even when its own module is unchanged.
Both same-partition and complete-module-equality KeyProduct reuse paths require equal namespace-directory and exact optional candidate list.

Native product Config includes optional exact candidates, distinguishing no policy, empty policy and selected policy. Historical native candidates are not authorization; mismatched policy fails current consumer Config binding.

Object hit still performs independent current machine preflight, reports actual object bytes fingerprint, current candidates and producer action key. It does not manufacture current DCE deletion counters. Resolving a producer to the same experimental block remains the separate quality-protocol responsibility.
Fresh report is obtained from the actual API producer and appended alongside actual object bytes fingerprint. Failure paths do not issue a successful report.

nearest_counterexamples: No external IR users is insufficient for an externally callable exported symbol: the explicit no-external-ZIL-exports contract is indispensable. The flag must not become a default private-visibility inference.

An available_externally imported body in another CGU may later lower to a call to the canonical external definition: all pre-O2 cross-unit references are scanned, so the canonical definition remains excluded.
Passing the candidate as an argument to an otherwise direct call is an address use: only the exact callee operand is exempt, so the argument still excludes it.
Changing references only in another unit can alter current deletion permission without changing this unit model: exact candidate lists are bound in both action keys and cached-key reuse checks.

llvm.used, compiler.used, global initializer, alias, metadata and remaining direct calls can retain a seemingly dead function: rooted metadata/alias domains are refused and current LLVM uses must be empty.
not_proven: No build, link, tests, executable runs, disassembly quality checks or performance measurements were performed by this reviewer.
Actual 425 workload admission through the conservative metadata gate and net speedup are not established by source review.
The new quality protocol and CLI integration are separate root-owned components, not covered by this frozen 9-file production review.
GlobalDCE may also remove transitively dead internal definitions; report.removed is deliberately the actual whole definition-set difference, not an invented count equal to selected candidates.
This is late removal of unused out-of-line definitions after full O2; it is not proof of complete O2 incrementalization or an MC/NativeRegion ownership solution.
